reader_sentence: Ablating only three of the 144 attention heads (L9H6, L9H9 and L10H0) raises the loss substantially, by 1.25, 0.91 and 0.72, while every other head has a near-zero effect, although the significance dots oddly appear only on small-effect heads and not on these three.
intended: Three heads matter: layer 9 head 6, layer 9 head 9 and layer 10 head 0; ablating any of the other 141 heads barely changes the loss.
reason: It names the same three heads (L9H6, L9H9, L10H0) as the only ones that matter and says all other heads have near-zero effect; the significance-dot remark is extra and doesn't contradict the finding.
